policy: Public-sector and research references only. External data are contextual/benchmarking inputs, never plant tags or OEM operating limits.

sources.title: US EPA UISIS-PNP Model Dataset
sources.publisher: US EPA Office of Research and Development
sources.coverage: US pulp and paper facilities; includes tissue as a product category; facility production/capacity/cost/fuel/emissions/energy-efficiency inputs, vintage data largely based on 2011 RISI inputs
sources.license_note: Public catalog entry; review EPA ScienceHub license linked in metadata before redistribution.
use: facility/product-level economic and energy scenario context
limitations: Historical data; not a current operating benchmark

sources.title: US EPA UISIS-PNP Model Outputs Example
sources.publisher: US EPA Office of Research and Development
sources.coverage: Illustrative model output workbooks for pulp and paper mitigation/economic analysis
sources.license_note: Public catalog entry; review EPA ScienceHub license before redistribution.
limitations: Illustrative model outputs, not live plant measurements

sources.title: Best Available Techniques Reference Document for Production of Pulp, Paper and Board
sources.publisher: European Commission Joint Research Centre / EIPPCB
sources.coverage: Process descriptions, environmental performance and indicative energy/water reference information across pulp, paper and board processes
sources.license_note: Use according to the document/site terms; retain citation and page references.
limitations: Reference values depend on process boundaries, grade, furnish and mill configuration; not OEM limits

sources.title: SFI Global Pulp and Paper Mill Database
sources.publisher: Spatial Finance Initiative / University of Oxford
sources.coverage: 3,403 global pulp and paper facilities; location, operating status, plant/product type, capacity, fuel, certification and ownership where available
sources.license_note: CC BY 4.0; download is provided through a request form, so it is not fetched automatically.
limitations: Not process telemetry; may not expose every field for every mill
